purpose: Frozen first OpenAI Direct core writing comparison. Freeze before any generation.

semanticCriteria.gate: At least 19 of 20 useful policy-ready drafts and zero critical meaning, recipient, instruction-leak, literal, privacy, or false-action errors.
semanticCriteria.minor: Faithful paraphrase or weak style counts as minor; a rejection is not useful.
semanticCriteria.review: Software output-policy acceptance plus explicit semantic review of each first output. No retries or production edits before grading.

cases.spoken: Hey, how's it going? Write this formally.
cases.exampleDraft: Hello, how are you?
cases.completionCriteria: Formal greeting; omit writing direction.

cases.spoken: Tell Priya the draft is ready for her review. Make this casual.
cases.exampleDraft: Hi Priya, the draft is ready for your review.
cases.completionCriteria: Address Priya; ready for review; casual.

cases.spoken: Tell Omar I cannot join the call today, but I can review the notes tomorrow. Keep it short.
cases.exampleDraft: Omar, I can't join today’s call, but I can review the notes tomorrow.
cases.completionCriteria: Keep both constraints and times; address Omar.

cases.spoken: Tell Lia the call is at 11 AM. Sorry, make that 12 PM. Ask her to confirm.
cases.exampleDraft: Lia, the call is at 12 PM. Can you confirm?
cases.completionCriteria: Only corrected time; address Lia; confirmation question.

cases.spoken: Tell Dev I can send the report Thursday if finance approves it Wednesday. Otherwise I need until Monday.
cases.exampleDraft: Dev, I can send the report Thursday if finance approves it Wednesday; otherwise, I need until Monday.
cases.completionCriteria: Preserve condition, all weekdays, and recipient.

cases.spoken: I might be mistaken, but I think the slowdown starts in the parser. Write this as a Codex reply.
cases.exampleDraft: I might be mistaken, but I think the slowdown starts in the parser.
cases.completionCriteria: Preserve uncertainty; omit placement direction; no invented diagnosis.

cases.spoken: Ask Codex to inspect literal verbatim src/Cache.swift end literal with literal flag no cache end literal. Do not edit any files.
cases.exampleDraft: Inspect src/Cache.swift with --no-cache. Do not edit any files.
cases.completionCriteria: Exact path and flag; recipient instruction preserved; no claimed execution.

cases.spoken: Tell Sara to revise only the introduction and leave the conclusion unchanged.
cases.exampleDraft: Sara, please revise only the introduction and leave the conclusion unchanged.
cases.completionCriteria: The editing instruction is for Sara, not Cadence.

cases.spoken: Tell Andre I cannot attend because of a personal appointment. Do not include the reason.
cases.exampleDraft: Andre, I cannot attend.
cases.completionCriteria: Address Andre, decline, omit personal appointment and writing direction.

cases.spoken: Tell Mei ticket ZX-42 is still under review and has not been approved.
cases.exampleDraft: Mei, ticket ZX-42 is still under review and has not been approved.
cases.completionCriteria: Exact ticket, recipient, negative status.

cases.spoken: The plan costs $75 per seat per month, not $75 for the entire team.
cases.exampleDraft: The plan costs $75 per seat per month, not $75 for the entire team.
cases.completionCriteria: Preserve amount, units, period, negative contrast.

cases.spoken: Write a note to Noah with the exact words "Wait until security approves".
cases.exampleDraft: Noah, Wait until security approves.
cases.completionCriteria: Noah and exact quoted text; no assistant introduction.

cases.spoken: Ask Tessa whether she can meet at 4 PM ET on Tuesday, not Wednesday.
cases.exampleDraft: Tessa, can you meet at 4 PM ET on Tuesday, not Wednesday?
cases.completionCriteria: Recipient, question, time, zone, weekday contrast.

cases.spoken: Tell Imani I appreciate her feedback and I would love to hear her thoughts on the revised outline. Make it warm.
cases.exampleDraft: Hi Imani, I appreciate your feedback and would love your thoughts on the revised outline.
cases.completionCriteria: Warm, recipient, appreciation, request; no direction leak.

cases.spoken: Put this into two bullets: the prototype is ready; the launch date is still undecided.
cases.exampleDraft:
- The prototype is ready.
- The launch date is still undecided.
cases.completionCriteria: Exactly two bullets; preserve uncertainty.

cases.spoken: I am not sure the export includes archived records. Can you check? Write this professionally.
cases.exampleDraft: I am unsure whether the export includes archived records. Could you please check?
cases.completionCriteria: Keep uncertainty and question; no invented answer.

cases.spoken: Write a prompt asking Codex to check the validation rule, but not submit the form.
cases.exampleDraft: Check the validation rule, but do not submit the form.
cases.completionCriteria: Recipient restriction survives; no claimed execution.

cases.spoken: Okay, I don't know what I'm doing, but I think this will work. Write it as a response in Codex.
cases.exampleDraft: I do not know what I am doing, but I think this will work.
cases.completionCriteria: Complete uncertainty, intended response; no scaffolding or backticks.

cases.spoken: Ask Jules to send the invoice number when she has a moment. Keep the message friendly.
cases.exampleDraft: Hi Jules, could you send me the invoice number when you have a moment?
cases.completionCriteria: Recipient, invoice number, no urgency invented; friendly.

cases.spoken: Tell Ren the refund is pending. Actually, the replacement is pending, not the refund.
cases.exampleDraft: Ren, the replacement is pending, not the refund.
cases.completionCriteria: Corrected subject and contrast; no claim refund is pending.
